records.findings_summary: Flag found via Forensics analysis of a Windows keyboard-layout file (.klc). The shift-state-0 column encoded Unicode arrows (U+2198, U+2192, U+2196, U+25A0) forming a trail over the 3-row keyboard grid, while the shift-state-1 column gave the character printed on each key. Following the arrows from Q produced a Hamiltonian path through every key spelling the flag.: sun{qwerty_sucks} | Evidence: suntrail.klc is an ASCII Windows Keyboard Layout Creator file (header KBD\tkbdusx\t"US"), category Forensics. ; LAYOUT rows are '<scancode>\t<VK>\t0\t<state0_char>\t<state1_char>\t-1'. State0 chars: U+2198(↘), U+2192(→), U+2196(↖), U+25A0(■) -> trail directions. State1 chars are ASCII letters. ; Key->char map (state1): Q=s W=w E=e R=s T=u A=u S=q D=r F=_ G=c H=} Z=n X={ C=t V=y B=k N=s. ; Applying directions (down/right/up) on the grid yields path Q->A->Z->X->S->W->E->D->C->V->F->R->T->G->B->N->H, visiting all 17 keys exactly once. ; Letters along the path = 'sun{qwerty_sucks}'.
solution_steps: 用 file/xxd 确认 suntrail.klc 是 Windows 键盘布局文件，属于 Forensics。
state0 列是 Unicode 箭头：U+2198(↘/向下)、U+2192(→/向右)、U+2196(↖/向上)、U+25A0(■=终点)，表示在键盘网格上的行进方向。
state1 列是每个键对应的字符。
把键盘排成 3 行网格（QWERT / ASDFGH / ZXCVBN），从 Q 出发按箭头逐键行进，得到哈密顿路径，读出字符。
路径为 Q A Z X S W E D C V F R T G B N H，字符拼出 sun{qwerty_sucks}。
提交该 flag，页面显示 Correct。
evidence: suntrail.klc is an ASCII Windows Keyboard Layout Creator file (header KBD\tkbdusx\t"US"), category Forensics.
LAYOUT rows are '<scancode>\t<VK>\t0\t<state0_char>\t<state1_char>\t-1'. State0 chars: U+2198(↘), U+2192(→), U+2196(↖), U+25A0(■) -> trail directions. State1 chars are ASCII letters.
Key->char map (state1): Q=s W=w E=e R=s T=u A=u S=q D=r F=_ G=c H=} Z=n X={ C=t V=y B=k N=s.
Applying directions (down/right/up) on the grid yields path Q->A->Z->X->S->W->E->D->C->V->F->R->T->G->B->N->H, visiting all 17 keys exactly once.
Submission via platform returned alert 'Correct' confirming the flag.
